{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the sentinel value in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check the revenue column: is it string? does it have commas?
print("Revenue dtype:", sales['revenue'].dtype)
print("First 5 revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for the QA orders
print("Number of rows with revenue == 999999.99:", (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", (sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check the distribution of converted
print("Number of converted customers:", (sales['converted'] == 1).sum())"}
